info.title: DentaBill API
info.description: Internal REST API for the DentaBill dashboard and CSV ingestion. Generated from Zod schemas — see ADR-017.

get.description: Readiness probe — server is ready to handle traffic. Tests Postgres and Redis readiness with 800ms timeout each.
Returns the authenticated DentaBill User and Organization for the current Clerk session.

patch.description: Update the current organization. Restricted to OWNER + ADMIN. NPI is required for payer dialling — empty values are accepted but block the Call Now action.

post.description: First-run onboarding for a Clerk-authenticated user. Idempotently creates the DentaBill Organization + User and stamps Clerk publicMetadata.
Create a claim under the authenticated user's organization.

get.description: List claims for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination, sortable by createdAt / serviceDate / priority / status, and filterable by status / payer / service-date range / claimNumber search.
Fetch a single claim by id, scoped to the auth organization.

patch.description: Patch a claim. Only fields supplied in the body are updated.

delete.description: Delete a claim. Hard-delete; soft-delete arrives in Phase 4.

get.description: Immutable claim findings and evidence. Acknowledgment never verifies payment.

post.description: Record a review against an unchanged current finding. Does not update claim status or financial values.
Publish findings from an existing saved inference receipt. Never sends a model request.

get.description: Owner/Admin review of an exact new-generation snapshot and any already saved authorization. Token allowance is an operational bound, not a dollar quote.

post.description: Persist explicit Owner/Admin authorization before bounded model work. Identical keys resume that same authorization; no automatic background queue is created.
Resume only an existing saved authorization. Never creates a new inference generation.
Reserve an outbound payer call intent and dispatch it. Repeated requests reuse the active intent; ambiguous provider submission requires reconciliation.

get.description: List calls for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination, filterable by status / payer / startedAt range. Sorted by `startedAt` desc with id tiebreaker.
Aggregate call/claim metrics for the dashboard overview tiles. Org-scoped: only the authenticated tenant's rows contribute.

amountCents.description: Unknown, never zero or claim face value. No reconciled payment ledger exists.

get.description: Fetch a single call with embedded CallEvent[] (timestamp asc) and a Claim summary. Cross-org access returns a uniform 404.

post.description: Request cancellation of an active call. The worker observes the durable request and asks the provider to stop; status and end time await provider evidence. Repeated requests and terminal calls are idempotent.

get.description: Fetch a saved legacy CallSummary. Returns 404 when the scoped call or summary is absent; use summary/status for processing state and native observation links.
Organization-scoped generation 1 analysis status. Only stored OWNER/ADMIN users may retry. No transcript, request, or provider response is returned.

post.description: OWNER/ADMIN-gated retry of summary generation for a terminal Call. Atomically reserves a durable delivery command and audit record; retry reservations are serialized for each call.
OWNER/ADMIN read-only check of an accepted call. Never starts or stops a call.

get.description: Read the current call submission status without exposing its identity snapshot.

post.description: OWNER/ADMIN review of an uncertain submission. Looks up the existing call; never starts a call.

get.description: Live call event stream (Server-Sent Events). Replays all persisted CallEvent rows in bounded pages, then catches up from Postgres with optional Redis wake-up hints. Heartbeat every 15s; closes after terminal call events are drained. See ADR-046.

post.description: Import claims using an explicit source database and stable source record IDs. Unchanged rows are skipped; conflicts are reported without overwriting existing work.

get.description: Aggregate billing usage for the calling org: current-month total + last 90 days of usage records (most recent first). Filters by organizationId via getOrgScopedDb so cross-org reads cannot leak.

post.description: Return a Stripe Customer Portal session URL. OWNER/ADMIN only. Phase 4 returns a stub URL when STRIPE_API_KEY is unset (test/dev); production wires the real Stripe SDK call.

Stripe webhook receiver. HMAC-verified. Phase 4 ships verification + replay-protection; live event routing lands in 4.5. Operates on request.rawBody captured by registerRawBodyPlugin so signature checks see byte-exact payload.

get.description: Operational call and distinct-claim metrics, denial observations, claim aging, and explicit payment-data availability. Workflow status and payer reports do not establish recovery.

callActivityByWeek.description: Calls started in the current and seven preceding UTC weeks, grouped by Monday. Distinct claims are counted per week and may recur across weeks.

amountCents.description: Unknown, never zero or claim face value. No reconciled payment ledger exists.

claimsMarkedResolvedCount.description: Distinct claims with current workflow status RESOLVED, among claims with calls. Does not establish payment or settlement.

get.description: List audit logs for the authenticated organization with cursor pagination. Sorted by `createdAt` desc with id tiebreaker.
